product_brief: A tamper-resistant, PQC-native Hardware Security Module serving as the cryptographic root of trust for sovereign, quantum-safe key management and PKI.
pqc_capability_description: The kNET HSM is PQC-native, supporting NIST-standardized algorithms ML-DSA (digital signatures) and ML-KEM (key establishment). It holds NIST CAVP validation for these PQC implementations, ensuring mathematical correctness and compliance. It serves as the root of trust for PQC-based PKI and protects data at rest.
key_management_model: HSM-backed hardware key storage; dedicated tamper-resistant hardware environment for key generation, management, protection, and use.
architecture_type: Hardware Security Module (HSM); on-prem appliance (implied by "appliance" context of HSM/Network Encryptor, though specific form factor like PCIe/USB is not explicitly detailed for kNET, only KeyGuardian is USB).
regulatory_status: Common Criteria EAL4+ (with ALC_FLR.3), NIST CAVP Validation for PQC, FIPS 140-2 Level 3
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports finalized NIST standards (ML-DSA, ML-KEM) finalized in 2024. Designed for immediate PQC transition to counter "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" threats.
testing_&_validation_methods: NIST CAVP Validation for PQC (ML-DSA, ML-KEM); Common Criteria EAL4+ evaluation; FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validation.
